why: Both proposals use the same tan leather sofa instead of a mustard velvet one, and the same low, wide etagere instead of a bookcase of the type requested. A's large blue and rust rug, patterned cushions, round wood coffee table and cotton throw give a colorful, cohesive bohemian look that suits the warm parquet. B's kilim rug, tufted lumbar pillows and tassel throw are more boho, but the cool white rice-paper lamp and the small drum table are weaker, and the black and white throw adds little color.
